name: Shaker
description: A man in his late twenties, the cousin who has appointed himself the party's mixologist, smooth and pleased with himself, who sings nu-disco.
build: A lean average adult man's build of ordinary proportions: medium shoulders, a trim waist, arms and legs of ordinary length, standing upright with straight knees.
face: Warm tan skin, hazel eyes under thick straight dark brows, a straight nose, a neatly trimmed short dark beard along the jaw, and medium lips.
hair: Dark-brown hair pulled back tight from the forehead into one large round man-bun high on the back of the crown, the sides short.
outfit: A crisp white short-sleeved button-up shirt tucked in, top button open; wide bright-red suspenders, one bold band over each shoulder, clipped to high-waisted navy chino trousers with the hems rolled once above the ankle; tan suede loafers with no socks. His forearms and hands are bare.
performance_style: Smooth and loose: feet hip-width apart, weight shifted onto the character-left leg. The character-right hand open and empty at chest height, palm up as if presenting, the character-left hand open and empty at his side. Head tilted slightly, a knowing half-smile.
location: The drinks corner of a suburban backyard in the evening: a wooden deck running to the bottom of the frame, a trestle table crowded with jugs of bright punch, lemons and a big blue picnic cooler, a wooden fence behind with warm globe string lights, and potted herbs along the rail.
recognition_cues: wide bright-red suspenders over a white short-sleeved shirt
navy chinos rolled above bare ankles
avoid: a bartender's waistcoat or bow tie
a drinks tray or cocktail shaker

sing.intent: Nu-disco vocal loop: sway the hips on the beat, raise the mic in the character-right hand to the mouth, roll the character-left shoulder and point the character-left finger upward on the hook, then return to the smooth loose stance. The mouth visibly opens wide and changes shape across the loop so he unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: A cold splash from the cooler startles him: the torso jerks back, both open hands lift to chest height, then he smooths his hair back and settles. No opponent, strike or contact.
animations.guard: One-shot stage self-protection: turn the character-left shoulder forward and raise both open hands in front of the chest, holding a cool braced stance. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: stroll in with a little shoulder groove, snap the suspenders with both thumbs, then land in the smooth loose stance.
